skills.name: Battle Buddy Pursena
skills.description: Links up with Pursena and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 2600% Area Damage  *Enemy ATK -40% (10 sec) *Enemy ATK Speed -40% (10 sec)

skills.name: Harsh Punishment
skills.description: Kneels to accept a tough scolding. Good effects on allies.  *Critical Rate +50% (7 sec) *Critical Damage +300% (7 sec) *Changes regular attacks to area attacks (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mushoku Tensei II
abilities.description: Mushoku Tensei II Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Skill Jammer
abilities.description: Extends skill reactivation times for the opposing team. (Effect increases as more Rangers with this ability join the battle.)
